messages.text: The field technician visit is set for Tuesday. Bring closed shoes.
I can come. Does the visit cost me anything?
Transfer LKR 5400 as the equipment bond before Tuesday or the tools stay in the cage.
I am not transferring a bond for tools I have not seen.
The ward assistant shift starts after a joining clinic visit.
Does the employer book that visit?
Pay the joining clinic fee of LKR 6100 before the shift, or your name comes off the list.
I will not pay a clinic fee to a chat.
My manager said to ask you to transfer LKR 4300 so the file opens.
Why does a file need a transfer from me?
They asked me to tell you to pay that today. Send LKR 4300 and quote your name.
No.
Give me your payroll password and the one-time code so I can check the account.
Payroll does not need my password.
Send the password and the OTP or the salary file stays closed.
I will not send either.
Uniform bond ekak LKR 4800 Thursday ta kalin transfer karanna. Nathi nam uniform eka denne ne.
Uniform eka company eken denna one ne da?
Bond eka oya transfer karanna one.
Mama eka karanne ne.
Medical card charge eka LKR 5300 Friday ta kalin gewanna. Nathi nam shift list eken nama eka ain wenawa.
Card eka company eken da?
Charge eka oya gewanna one.
Mama gewanne ne.
Manager kiyala oyata kiyanna kiyala kiwwa. LKR 3900 pay karanna file eka open wenna.
Mama danata pay karanna one da?
Ow. Eka salli eka adha transfer karanna.
Naha.
Payroll password eka saha OTP eka ewanna. Account eka check karanna one.
Password ekak mama denne ne.
OTP eka thawa danna. Nathi nam salary file eka close.
Naha.
We reimburse the clinic visit after you join. You do not pay us.
So I keep the receipt and the company pays me back?
Yes. There is no joining clinic fee to send in this chat.
I will bring the receipt on the first day.
Your salary of Rs 52000 is transferred to your account on the last Friday. There is no fee.
Do you need my password for that?
No. Do not share an OTP or your banking password. Send only the account number on the payroll form.
I will fill the form at the office.
Someone promised a field job, then asked for an equipment bond. I did not pay. Is that a scam?
Yes. Do not transfer a bond to a chat. Our visit has no charge.
I blocked the number.
Good. Bring your CV on Tuesday and nothing else.
The ward assistant interview is Wednesday at the office. Bring your CV. There is no payment.
Any form to fill before I arrive?
No. We do not ask for a fee, a password, or a code.
See you Wednesday.
Clinic eke bill eka company eken reimburse karanawa. Oya gewanna one ne.
Receipt eka genna enna da?
Ow. Fee ekak chat ekata danna one ne.
Hari.
Salary eka last Friday account ekata danawa. Fee ekak naha.
Password ekak one da?
Naha. OTP eka share karanna epa. Account number eka witharai form eke.
Form eka office eke fill karannam.
Uniform bond ekak gewanna kiyala kiwwa. Mama dunne ne. Eka scam da?
Ow. Salli denna epa. Ape interview ekata bond ekak naha.
Mama block kale.
Hari.
Interview eka Wednesday office eke. CV eka genna. Payment ekak naha.
Monava hari code ekak one da?
Naha. Password ekakuth code ekakuth epa.
Wednesday enawa.
